speaker: A2ABFXJB7DKIBQ
text: Have you heard about Save the Children?

speaker: A2QBBJCOCZPTYR
text: Yes I have, seems like a good org

speaker: A2ABFXJB7DKIBQ
text: It really is. Donations help individual children and their families.It ensures health, education and safety.

speaker: A2QBBJCOCZPTYR
text: I always wonder about the overhead and admin costs that come off the top of donations

speaker: A2ABFXJB7DKIBQ
text: A lot of organizations seem to have issues with overhead. I was amazed to see that over 86 percent goes into their programs. Only 5% is for management and 9% to fundraising.

speaker: A2QBBJCOCZPTYR
text: Those are good numbers, shows that most of the money goes to the kids and not big salaries.

speaker: A2ABFXJB7DKIBQ
text: 44 percent alone goes to health, nutrition, and hunger. In 2017 alone, they reached 155million children. 237K in the U.S

speaker: A2QBBJCOCZPTYR
text: That's fantastic, they've helped a lot!

speaker: A2ABFXJB7DKIBQ
text: And sadly, there is still so much more to do. In just one area, Syria, millions of Syrian children have grown up facing the daily threat of violence. n the first two months of 2018 alone, 1,000 children were reportedly killed or injured!

speaker: A2QBBJCOCZPTYR
text: I would be afraid aid meant to be given to the children would be seized by those in power and never reach the kids.

speaker: A2ABFXJB7DKIBQ
text: I had wondered about that myself. They work closely with the U.N  and other organizations in the local area to be sure it gets to those in need and not the aggressors.

speaker: A2QBBJCOCZPTYR
text: Hopefully those organizations aren't as corrupt as has been reported in the media.  You just don't know what to believe any more.

speaker: A2ABFXJB7DKIBQ
text: That is true. This one seems to have been around for awhile and seems to be highly rated though. Have you ever had a chance to donate to Save the Children?

speaker: A2QBBJCOCZPTYR
text: Yes, years ago I remember a presentation and we did donate then.  I have since been donating to local animal rescue groups.  They really need the help.

speaker: A2ABFXJB7DKIBQ
text: Yeah, I have donated little amounts here and there as I can. Though the shelters everywhere seem to need help as well! I give little bits when I can. Would you be interested in giving a small donation??

speaker: A2QBBJCOCZPTYR
text: I would definitely consider it.

speaker: A2ABFXJB7DKIBQ
text: Any little bit helps any of these organizations. Everyone's little bits add up to so much more!

speaker: A2QBBJCOCZPTYR
text: You are right.  How much do you think I should donate to Save the Children?

speaker: A2ABFXJB7DKIBQ
text: There is a way to have one deducted from your task payment. You can choose any amount from $0 to all your payment ($2). I personally do a little when I really need the money. Anywhere from a dime to a quarter. When I read something devastating, earned a good amount at work or feel better financially, it is more.

speaker: A2QBBJCOCZPTYR
text: Okay, thanks for your input.  I will donate $1.00

speaker: A2ABFXJB7DKIBQ
text: Wow! That is amazing! They will be glad to have it!!!
